newsitem.title: FRANCE: De Silguy sees EMU decision end-April 1998.
newsitem.headline: De Silguy sees EMU decision end-April 1998.

text.p: European Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy was quoted as saying on Thursday he expected European Union leaders to decide at the end of April 1998 which countries qualify for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) in 1999.

He told a parliamentary committee that the European Commission and European Monetary Institute would recommend which countries were eligible to join on the basis of final figures for 1997 economic performance, expected by the end of February.

"The two reports and recommendations will therefore not be available before mid-March. According to the first indications collected by the Commission, six weeks will be needed for a satisfactory national and European parliamentary process," he said according to a report of his statement to a French parliamentary committee.
"This means that we would have a decision (on EMU membership) towards the end of April," he said.
He added that the question of when to decide on EMU membership would be discussed at a meeting of EU finance ministers and central bankers in Noordwijk, in the Netherlands, in April.
De Silguy is responsible for economic and monetary affairs.
